what_to_run: From frozen OOF predictions, aggregate all ERIN grade-task predictions to one prediction per patient using the pre-specified aggregation rule, then recompute AUROC, paired fusion-minus-histology CIs, and the full jury/pathladder/feasibility cross-evaluation matrix at patient level. gap: Final-pipeline shuffled-label/permutation controls are not evidenced for the final TCGA ABMIL-Cox survival task or ERIN grade/progression tasks; OCCAMS v3 shows only a single shuffled realization rather than the promised empirical null.
claim_at_risk: Validity of the OCCAMS and TCGA external fusion-null claims, and the ERIN histology/clinical/fusion claims, under the thesis-wide pipeline-invalidation rule.
what_to_run: Run patient-level label permutations through the identical final CV, preprocessing, model-selection, and OOF pipeline for: OCCAMS v3 Cox arms, TCGA ABMIL-Cox arms, ERIN patient-level grade arms, and ERIN progression arms. gap: Central paired bootstrap claims do not incorporate training-seed/model-fit uncertainty; the reported CIs appear to resample fixed OOF predictions.
claim_at_risk: The claimed SWG primary-encoder fusion advantage and the precision of the small-cohort OCCAMS, TCGA, and ERIN progression fusion conclusions.
